channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Paul Millsap | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Paul Millsap from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Darren Wolfson on Paul Millsap, Dennis Schroeder, Josh Hart, Lauri Markkanen
item.description:
“I can tell you the Wolves have kicked the tires on Paul Millsap, on Josh Hart, on Dennis Schroeder, on Lauri Markkanen,”

Darren Wolfson on Paul Millsap, Dennis Schroeder, Josh Hart, Lauri Markkanen, Aug 10, 2021. Source: ahnfiredigital.com.

item.title: Monty Williams on Paul Millsap, JaMychal Green, Dario Saric
item.description:
Gerald Bourguet:Monty on Dario Saric minutes:

“We just felt like Dario gives us a little bit of know-how against JaMychal Green and Paul Millsap.”

Monty Williams on Paul Millsap, JaMychal Green, Dario Saric, Jun 8, 2021. Source: Twitter @GeraldBourguet.

item.title: Michael Malone on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Coach Malone on Paul Millsap:

“This is my fourth year with him and this might be the most engaged I’ve seen him, the most vocal I’ve seen him.”

Michael Malone on Paul Millsap, Dec 21, 2020. Source: Twitter @katywinge.

item.title: Michael Porter on Paul Millsap, Isaiah Thomas
item.description:
“I grew up vegetarian because my mom was always really health aware, but seeing how these guys recover — especially the older guys like Paul Millsap, and Isaiah Thomas when he was here — whether they play good or bad, their routine stays the same. I try to take a lot of that from them and just try to take care of my body in order to be ready to go every game.”

Michael Porter on Paul Millsap, Isaiah Thomas, Jan 16, 2020. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Jerry Colangelo on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Jerry Colangelo on why Paul Millsap was included in the player pool for USA Basketball’s training camp:

“First of all he’s a terrific competitor... We need veterans who know how to play, who have the size and strength and experience to compete.”

Jerry Colangelo on Paul Millsap, Jun 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Jamal Murray on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Jamal Murray on Paul Millsap last night to @3DTV:

“He’s the MVP of our team right now. What he does on and off the court, what he says, how much he talks, how he holds himself in the game it’s contagious. We need that from him in the playoffs and tonight was just another example”

Jamal Murray on Paul Millsap, Apr 17, 2019. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Paul Millsap
item.description:
“He’s not the Paul Millsap that we signed this summer, that played before he got hurt, because he is limited. He’s not able to play as effectively as he has been his whole career. “It’s a fine line of going to him and trying to help him get into a rhythm,but not also putting a burden on him where he feels like he has to carry a load. Because I don’t know if he’s ready to carry that load.”

Michael Malone on Paul Millsap, Mar 22, 2018. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Michael Malone on Paul Millsap's confidence that the #Nuggets will improve defensively down the stretch:

“Hopefully (he) has an impact on our other players. And it can’t just be, 'Well, Paul’s back, he’s gonna cover up all my mistakes.'”

Michael Malone on Paul Millsap, Mar 2, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Trey Lyles on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Trey Lyles on his minutes decrease w/Millsap's return:

“It’s definitely frustrating. But (while) playing behind an all-star power forward, you gotta take what you can get. Now that he’s back, I realize that. I’m not happy with it, but I’m gonna do the best that I can.”

Trey Lyles on Paul Millsap, Mar 1, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Michael Malone on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Michael Malone on Paul Millsap's impending return, which could be as soon as a week away:

“For (teammates) to know that he’s inching closer and closer to coming back, that gives an already confident group even more confidence, because they know what Paul brings to the table.”

Michael Malone on Paul Millsap, Feb 25, 2018. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on how the #Nuggets have won without Paul Millsap in the first half of the season:

“....We don't need him.....(laughs). I'm not kidding. We really need him.”

Nikola Jokic on Paul Millsap, Jan 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @TJMcBrideNBA.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on Paul Millsap's injury:

“I’m kind of sad, because he’s a big part of our new thing with what we’re trying to do ... He’s a great player, an All-Star. We’re going to miss him on the court. He’s a go-to guy when we need a bucket.”

Nikola Jokic on Paul Millsap, Nov 22, 2017. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Michael Malone on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Gina Mizell:Mike Malone on Paul Millsap's first practice with the #Nuggets:

“He plays with a poise and he’s never rushing. He’s never out of control.”

Michael Malone on Paul Millsap, Sep 26, 2017. Source: Twitter @ginamizell.

item.title: Malik Beasley on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Malik Beasley on the Nuggets being an attractive destination for players:

“It says a lot. Denver may be a smaller, up-and-coming city, but a lot of people realize that we’re coming to compete. It all depends on the players and we have a great group of guys who are unselfish and want to compete for a championship. As you saw, Paul Millsap is coming over and hopefully we keep getting more players [to choose Denver] so that, in the future, we’ll be a great team.”

Malik Beasley on Paul Millsap, Jul 31, 2017. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Tim Connelly on Paul Millsap
item.description:
TJ McBride:Connelly on Millsap:

“This is a guy who we chased aggressively for 4 years. This isn’t just a signing but the right signing.”

Tim Connelly on Paul Millsap, Jul 13, 2017. Source: Twitter @TJMcBrideNBA.

item.title: Antony Ressler on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Ressler said of the rumor.

“I think that’s what basketball operations people do for a living. I actually believe the more they do that, the more it gets in the public domain. Yes, I read some of the stuff. Yes, I was told people call and people ask. We are in the Paul Millsap business. At least we are trying our best to be. Our job is to try to make him want to be here, both financially and emotionally. We are trying. That I can promise you.”

Antony Ressler on Paul Millsap, Apr 24, 2017. Source: Atlanta Journal-Constitution.

item.title: Kelly Oubre on Paul Millsap
item.description:
“I tell him that every day. Obviously, people respect Millsap. I respect Millsap to the fullest, but we have one of the best power forwards in the game of basketball right now with this team. He goes out and shows that every day.”

Kelly Oubre on Paul Millsap, Apr 16, 2017. Source: CSNMidAtlantic.

item.title: Wes Wilcox on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Atlanta Hawks General Manager Wes Wilcox:

“Paul Millsap is not going to be traded. And Paul Millsap is absolutely our priority this offesason in re-signing him with the Atlanta Hawks.”

Wes Wilcox on Paul Millsap, Feb 22, 2017. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Kyle Korver on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Chris Vivlamore:Kyle Korver on Paul Millsap:

“He keeps on adding to his game. Lots of times when guys get bigger contracts, you don’t always see that.”

Kyle Korver on Paul Millsap, Jan 30, 2016. Source: Twitter @CVivlamoreAJC.

item.title: Danny Ferry on Paul Millsap
item.description:
Chris Vivlamore:Danny Ferry on pursuit of Paul Millsap:

“He was a priority for us from the start. He got the call at 12:01 (a.m. on July 1).”

Danny Ferry on Paul Millsap, Jul 10, 2013. Source: Twitter @ajchawks.
